payload.acceptance_criteria: When a lane is cut or rebased onto main, then it carries no chore(tracker) commit that copies a main tracker commit, and the landing does not stop on a .basicly/ledger conflict
payload.description:
## Context
When a code lane shares the main ledger through its redirect, I want its tracker writes to stay off the lane branch, so a landing never stops on a ledger conflict. 2026-11-19: two landings stopped with REBASE-CONFLICTS in .basicly/ledger/pending-main.jsonl: dev-tier-model (lane commit 7c18ccf4, a copy of main's e93bacf2) and dev-pipe-guard (copies of 766aa939 and 5e1f373a). Both were re-cut from main with a cherry-pick of the code commits. Orchestrator 2026-11-19 12:11 UTC. Not built.
payload.title: lane tooling keeps tracker commits out of code lanes
